adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: Exact frozen numerical evidence reproduces, including losing controls; this verifies computation, not universal interpretation.

mechanism.rationale: Numerical replay does not identify a microscopic mechanism or validate signs of fitted empirical components.

novelty.rationale: No literature-priority adjudication in this computational review.

significance.rationale: Reusable scoped benchmark comparison. Entire contiguous probe-Rabi blocks; one vapor cell. No independent atomic-cell replication.; The asymmetric dual-response equation improves prediction on two reserved contiguous Rabi blocks compared with the single-line and polynomial controls. Its practical contribution is a scoped response surrogate with explicit uncertainty about mechanism, not a new atomic law.; No independent population confidence interval from dependent rows.

reproducibility.rationale: Native-source reconstruction and every saved model/metric passed independent computation.

impact.rationale: No independent deployed intervention/cost/safety outcome was measured.

checks: Independently reparsed hash-verified native source and matched every confirmation predictor/target/identity
All top-level groups disjoint across development and confirmation
Replayed every model with permitted predictors only, excluding undeclared condition metadata
Independently recomputed equal-group physical-unit MAE for every model
Inspected target semantics, same-condition calibration, source processing and pre-confirmation freeze
limitations: Entire contiguous probe-Rabi blocks; one vapor cell.
